schedules.area_note: Rear-yard collection; containers max 30 gal / 50 lb; collection from 5:30 a.m.
Rear-yard collection; containers max 30 gal / 50 lb; collection from 5:30 a.m.
Commingled and paper/cardboard; set out Tuesday p.m. for Wednesday a.m. pickup from 5:30 a.m.

2026 bulk trash days: January 26, March 2, April 13, June 8, July 20, September 14, November 23. Items at curb by 12:00 p.m. on pickup day; may be placed up to three days prior. No concrete or construction debris. Freon items $20, tire off rim $2, tire on rim $5 (pay at Borough Hall before pickup).
Leaves may be placed loose at curb September–December; otherwise containerized at curb. Grass clippings not collected. Brush tied in bundles max 4 ft / 50 lb or containerized.
Dried-out paint cans (less than 1 in. paint remaining) with household trash in rear yard
Dried-out paint cans (less than 1 in. paint remaining) with household trash in rear yard

allenhurst.notes: Household hazardous waste directed to Monmouth County HHW Facility, Shafto Road, Tinton Falls (732-683-8686); not a borough drop-off. Bulk and freon/tire collections require advance payment at Borough Hall for listed fees.
